item.title: K8S Workloads in Action: Deep Dive into Job, CronJob, and DaemonSet with MySQL Backup & Restore Practice
item.description: An in-depth exploration of batch processing and daemon workloads in Kubernetes: from the backoffLimit retry mechanism of Pi calculation Jobs, to hands-on multi-database backup and cross-environment restore using Jobs with dual NFS volumes, followed by CronJob scheduling validation and DaemonSet node taint troubleshooting.
